instruction: Write a detailed, high-quality model answer recommending Addleshaw Goddard’s unique selling points to a potential new client. Stay within roughly 300 words, use only the permitted facts, and invent no rankings, products, or awards beyond those named.
input: If you were an AG lawyer, recommending the firm to a potential new client - what would you describe as our most unique selling points? (approx. 300 words max)
output:
As an Addleshaw Goddard lawyer pitching to a prospective client, I would put innovation at the centre of the firm’s unique selling points—anchored by its Financial Times recognition as a top 10 innovative firm.

What matters commercially is how that innovation operates. It is not confined to a standalone innovation unit. Every member of staff is expected to engage with innovation and to put ideas forward through established firm-wide processes. That non-hierarchical model means the lawyers working on a client’s matter are themselves generating solutions, rather than innovation being reserved for a small internal group. Against rival approaches that silo creativity, this is a material differentiator: clients get problem-solving from the people who know their issues best.

AG also designs processes around the client. Through AG Consulting, the firm partners with general counsel and in-house legal teams on issues specific to each organisation—risk-management, spending analytics, and corporate governance among them. Innovation is therefore not abstract; it is calibrated so that delivery remains tailored and client-focused.

Financial and delivery discipline reinforce that offer. Intelligent Delivery uses legal project management to strengthen how work is run. Planning services in advance supports a more efficient pricing structure. Combined with a clear grasp of both legal and business needs, AG presents itself as more than a traditional law firm—an adviser structured to innovate with the client, not merely for them.
generation_notes: Detailed three-pillar USP rewrite: FT innovation ranking, firm-wide non-hierarchical ideation, AG Consulting, Intelligent Delivery/pricing; no new products or awards.
